no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Company sells regenerative-medicine biologic products (Zofin, DayZero MSCs, Wharton's Jelly matrix, Patient Pure X exosomes, amniotic-membrane patches) primarily under Florida SB 1768 commercial channels. The only IND-based clinical trials sponsored by ZEO are Zofin in COPD (NCT05643729, SUSPENDED, primary completion 2024-05-30) and two completed Zofin COVID-19 studies (NCT05228899, NCT04384445). The recently announced Cytora Therapeutics / Made Scientific partnership (Jan 2026) for an allogeneic oral mucosal stem cell therapy contemplates a future Phase 2b trial in the US, but no IND has been filed and no NCT exists yet — therefore PRE-LAUNCH and excluded.
